# Code Review — 2026-08-18

Scope: current `main` (v0.1.1, head 8cf45b4) with focus on this cycle's commits v0.1.0..HEAD (#28 audit fixes + metadata/JSON-LD refresh, #29/#31 action bumps, #30 README badges, #32/#34 dependency bumps, #39 test suites for consent/language/routing + gate widening, #40 logo cleanup + compression, #42 release prep). Evidence base: full diff `git diff v0.1.0..HEAD`, direct reads of `index.html`, `src/App.tsx`, `src/components/CookieConsent.tsx`, `src/components/ToolPage.tsx` (partial), `src/config/{analytics,features,tune}.ts`, `src/config/products.tsx`, `src/context/LanguageContext.tsx` (detection + fallback), the three new test suites, workflows, and a fresh `npm run coverage` run (61/61 pass).

## Verdict on this cycle's commits

- The cycle was test- and hygiene-only in `src/`: three behavior-focused suites (`App.test.tsx`, `CookieConsent.test.tsx`, `LanguageContext.test.tsx`) plus the coverage-gate widening in `vitest.config.ts`. Production source changes were limited to `index.html` metadata (17-tool story + Meet in JSON-LD — the 2026-08-13 SEO finding, verified fixed: meta description, `og:description`, `twitter:description` and all 17 `ItemList` entries present and consistent with the route table in `src/App.tsx:20-43` and the 17 products in `src/config/products.tsx`).
- The new suites are high quality: they test observable behavior (consent matrix with mocked `initGA`, storage contracts, fake timers for the slide-in delay, browser-language detection via `navigator.languages` stubbing, `t()` fallback chain, hash → view/title mapping), assert real outcomes (141 assertions / 61 tests = 2.3 per test), and are cleanly AAA-structured. No coverage-only tests.
- Asset work (#40) removed 9.6 MB of unreferenced product logos from the deploy path and compressed the three referenced logos (936 KB → 36 KB, ~500 KB → ~19/21 KB). Deploy payload finding from 2026-08-13 resolved.

## Findings

No new actionable security, UX/DX, architecture or performance TODOs with strong evidence. Specifically checked and clean:

- Consent flow remains fail-closed: GA only after explicit opt-in (`src/components/CookieConsent.tsx:29-31,71-73`), `trackEvent` no-ops without consent (`src/config/analytics.ts:79`), storage errors fail closed in `hasAnalyticsConsent` (`src/config/analytics.ts:57-63`).
- Feature flags are env-driven (`src/config/features.ts:5`, `src/config/tune.ts:116-117`) — no compile-time-hidden code paths, CodeQL-clean.
- No secrets in the tree; the GA measurement ID is a public identifier. No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`/`eval` in `src/`.
- Routing/title mapping is now test-covered, including the hidden-Pro-route fallback (`src/App.test.tsx`).

The one structural item that remains open is the coverage-gate scope: `src/components/ToolPage.tsx` (1011 lines — product rendering, FAQ toggle, copy-to-clipboard, `proHint` parsing, Tune funnel wiring) is the largest untested behavior component and sits outside the gate. That is tracked as the single finding in this cycle's coverage report (`.github/coverage/2026-08-18T14-49-33Z.md`) and as a GitHub issue — not duplicated here.

## Trivial fix applied in this cycle's PR

- `src/components/CookieConsent.tsx:51` — `localStorage.removeItem` in the `reset-cookie-consent` event handler was the only unguarded storage access in the file (every other access is wrapped in try/catch for storage-blocked environments). Wrapped it to match the file's own fail-closed convention. No behavior change in normal browsers.

## Conclusion

This cycle's commits are verified sound and the previous cycle's review findings are all resolved. No new TODOs manufactured. The recommended next increment is the ToolPage coverage suite tracked in the coverage report.
